name: @growth-os/cybertroic
description: GROWTH OS Cybertroic — the platform guardian/security service. A deterministic, tiered-model sentry (Sentry → Investigator → Specialist) that consumes the money/control event backbone (wallet.*, treasury.float.*, credit.consumed, action.plan.created/signed, action.executed), classifies each fact cheaply, and ESCALATES security-shaped events (spend-velocity anomaly, step-up reuse, float exhaustion, config drift) into a SecurityIncident — emitting security.incident / guardian.briefing and briefing the owner. It DETECTS + TRIAGES + RECOMMENDS + BRIEFS; destructive/irreversible containment always routes through the AI Manager firewall step-up rail, never here.
